question: A 4-year-old boy is brought to the physician because of a 3-day history of fever and left ear pain. Examination of the left ear shows a bulging tympanic membrane with green discharge. Gram stain of the discharge shows a gram-negative coccobacillus. The isolated organism grows on chocolate agar. The causal pathogen most likely produces a virulence factor that acts by which of the following mechanisms?

options.opa: Binding of the Fc region of immunoglobulins
